i.content:
# trailtrim

Simplify GPX tracks: fewer points, same shape. trailtrim applies the Ramer-Douglas-Peucker algorithm with a tolerance in metres and can drop low-accuracy fixes.

## Install

```sh
cargo install trailtrim   # requires Rust 1.74+
```

## Usage

```sh
# simplify with the default 5 m tolerance, write to stdout
trailtrim ride.gpx > ride.small.gpx

# 10 m tolerance, to a file
trailtrim ridge_loop.gpx -t 10 -o ridge_loop.small.gpx

# drop poor fixes and keep timestamps, reading stdin
cat run.gpx | trailtrim - --max-hdop 8 --keep-time
```

On the sample track in `tests/fixtures/ridge_loop.gpx`, `-t 10` reduces 4,812 points to 311.

## Options

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<INPUT>` | | GPX file, or `-` for stdin |
| `-o, --output` | stdout | Output file |
| `-t, --tolerance` | 5 | RDP tolerance in metres |
| `--max-hdop` | off | Drop points with worse horizontal accuracy (metres) |
| `--keep-time` | off | Keep timestamps (stripped by default) |

## License

MIT OR Apache-2.0
